title: Save Branch as Scene Does Not Save Branch and Crashes DEBUG
body: ### Tested versions 4.7.2 mono stable ### System information OS Name Microsoft Windows 11 Home - Version 10.0.26200 Build 26200- Processor 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i7-1255U, 1700 Mhz, 10 Core(s), 12 Logical Processor(s) ### Issue description On this version of Godot, starting debug with run current scene and going from local to remote and doing the below causes the debug to crash and nothing to save in the folder I wanted to save that branch. I am trying to save the control node shown below because I want to delete: 1. "hscrollbar" 2. "vscrollbar" Without deleting the ability to pan. This controlnode is internal because it belongs to a GraphEdit. I can imagine that this is happening because the engine is trying to strip GraphEdit of a required internal component while the debugger is open. I think a error and crash here is fine, but the below procedure is better i think: 1. user wants to strip graphedit of vscrollbar and hscrollbar 2. user starts current scene debug with f6 3. user goes on remote tab in scene tree 4. user tries to port branch to local 5. godot freezes debug menu and gives a warning and says the debugger will crash 6. remote internal node is now in local under its parent and saved a scene ### Steps to reproduce 1. user wants to strip graphedit of vscrollbar and hscrollbar 2. user starts current scene debug with f6 3. user goes on remote tab in scene tree 4. user tries to port branch to local 5. ~godot crashes~ and closes debug 6. done edit: godot does not crash. ### Minimal reproduction project (MRP) n/a i think
